# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`.

VictusControl is a future open-source C#/.NET Windows utility for the HP Victus Gaming Laptop 16-s0035nt / 7Z5Z2EA.

Prefer small, focused edits. Use existing abstractions once they exist. Do not generate unrelated code, broad scaffolding, or speculative hardware logic.

Do not read or use reference repositories unless explicitly asked. Avoid whole-repo context. Search first, then inspect exact files.

Update or add focused tests when behavior changes. Do not commit, push, or create branches unless the user explicitly asks.
